statement: Find all prime numbers \(p\) and \(q\) such that \(p^2 + q = 37q^2 + p\).

Game pieces are unit squares whose four sides are each colored with one of four colors (blue, red, yellow, green), one color per side, with every possible color arrangement represented and one million copies of each kind. Rectangular puzzles are assembled without gaps or overlaps so that two pieces sharing a side have that side the same color. Determine whether it is possible to make a rectangle of \(99 \times 2007\) with each border side having one color. What about \(100 \times 2008\)? And \(99 \times 2008\)?

Let \(ABCD\) be a parallelogram with \(AB > AD\). Suppose the ratio of the diagonals is \(\dfrac{AC}{BD} = 3\). Let \(r\) be the line symmetric to \(AD\) with respect to \(AC\), and \(s\) the line symmetric to \(BC\) with respect to \(BD\). If \(r\) and \(s\) intersect at \(P\), find the ratio \(\dfrac{PA}{PB}\).

Ten real numbers \(a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{10}\) are given, and the 45 pairwise sums \(a_i + a_j\) (\(1 \leq i < j \leq 10\)) are formed. It is known that not all of these sums are integers. Determine the minimum value of \(k\) such that it is possible for exactly \(k\) of the 45 sums to be non-integers and the remaining \(45 - k\) to be integers.
A positive integer is called lucky if the sum of its digits is divisible by 31. What is the maximum possible difference between two consecutive lucky numbers?

Julián chooses 2007 points in the plane with no three collinear, and draws in red all segments joining two of those points. Roberto then draws several lines, aiming to cut each red segment in its interior by at least one line. Determine the minimum number \(\ell\) of lines such that, no matter how Julián places the 2007 points, Roberto can always achieve his objective with \(\ell\) appropriately chosen lines.
